description: Troubleshoot and fix UI chatbot credential error
context: Backend server not running. AWS credentials are valid (root account). Need to start backend server.
Found the issue: Need to import Bedrock Agent VS4IAMTUZO to AgentCore Runtime, then frontend calls Runtime endpoint, not Gateway directly.
Found the root cause: Bedrock Agent VS4IAMTUZO has no Action Groups configured. Need to add Action Group pointing to AgentCore Gateway to access the 7 security tools.
